item.title: Mayor wants Sarpy County Museum to stay in Bellevue
item.description: KMTV obtained the lease agreement between the museum and the city, which shows the museum secured rights to the property for just one dollar back in 1977. The lease extends until 2076.

item.title: Crescent community plans unique outdoor charter school to replace closed elementary
item.description: Crescent, Iowa neighbors are turning the loss of their elementary school into an opportunity for innovative education. The Red Barn Schoolhouse will have students learning outdoors half the day. 🌱📚

item.title: City 'in discussions' with owner of vacant southwest Omaha hotel for the demolition
item.description: KMTV has confirmed that there are conversations happening between the city and the building owner to demolish the abandoned hotel near 108th and L Streets.
